'''''Seswennan Nightcloak''''' was a [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Battle of Fleyars IV]]. Following the death of its captain in the battle, the ship was commanded by [[Akal Zed]].
